name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 176 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 30% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata.
status.nb: 176 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 30 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Kolkata.

summary.en: Security forces have launched a joint operation in Kulgam, Jammu and Kashmir, and conducted surprise night inspections of religious sites in Srinagar, arresting a person for spreading false information about the attack. In Manipur, Naga civilians were killed on the Imphal-Ukhrul highway and a Kuki woman was killed, prompting a bandh and intensified security operations that included the arrest of five militants linked to Myanmar arms supplies. The CRPF has redeployed an anti-Naxal battalion from Chhattisgarh to Manipur, and district commissioners have set up social media cells after two security personnel were killed in Kishtwar. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker har igangsatt en felles operasjon i Kulgam, Jammu og Kashmir, og gjennomført overraskende nattinspeksjoner av religiøse steder i Srinagar, hvor de arresterte en person for å spre falsk informasjon om angrepet. I Manipur ble Naga-sivilister drept på Imphal-Ukhrul-veien, og en Kuki-kvinne ble drept, noe som førte til en bandh og intensiverte sikkerhetsoperasjoner som inkluderte arrestasjonen av fem militante knyttet til våpenforsyninger fra Myanmar. CRPF har omplassert et anti-Naxal-bataljon fra Chhattisgarh til Manipur, og distriktskommissærer har opprettet sosiale-medie-celler etter at to sikkerhetspersonell ble drept i Kishtwar. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
